## ecmcEX72XX_OPT.cmd

[Source: hardware/Beckhoff_7XXX/ecmcEX72XX_OPT.cmd](https://github.com/paulscherrerinstitute/ecmccfg/blob/master/hardware/Beckhoff_7XXX/ecmcEX72XX_OPT.cmd)

Documented configuration options:

- MODE CSV (default), CSP, CST or CSTCA
- TP 0 or 1, device default
- INFO2 INPUTS, TEMP, ERRORS or NONE, subject to device capabilities
- DIAG 0 or 1, device default (velocity, torque, DC voltage)
- ENC_STAT 0 or 1; default 1 where supported, otherwise 0
- SYNC_0_CYCLE Sync 0 period [ns], family default
- SYNC_0_SHIFT Sync 0 shift [ns], device default
- SYNC_1_CYCLE Sync 1 period [ns], family default
- SYNC_1_SHIFT Sync 1 shift [ns], default 0
- WATCHDOG_DIVIDER Watchdog divider, default derived from sample rate
- WATCHDOG_INTERVALS Watchdog intervals, default derived from sample rate
